rows.grounds: indeclinable absolutive dattvā (having given); kept as given.
optative/injunctive saṃpūjayet (one should worship); form kept as given (saṃpūjayed).
vocative brahman (O Brahman); form kept as given (brahmann).
accusative plural upacārān (offerings/services); form kept as given (upacārāṃś).
